title: Psych-101
authors: Marcel Binz and co-authors of the Centaur paper (dataset card citation; point of contact Marcel Binz)
description: 'A data set of natural language transcripts from human psychological experiments': trial-by-trial data from 160 experiments and 60,092 participants making 10,681,650 choices, one row per participant, with human choices marked by '<<' and '>>' tokens. Training data for Centaur (record binz-centaur-2025).
rightsNotes: Dataset card metadata: license 'apache-2.0'; Licensing Information section: 'Apache License 2.0'. No further terms of use are stated.
The terms attached to the 160 original experiments' data were not checked; the card states only the Apache-2.0 licence for the transcribed dataset.

The held-out test set (marcelbinz/Psych-101-test) is a separate gated repository under 'cc-by-nd-4.0' with the instruction 'Do not redistribute outside of this repository'. It is not part of this record and is not accessed.
